In February 2026, Tencent Hunyuan rebuilt its pre-training and reinforcement learning infrastructure, along with three principles guiding the pursuit of practical models: 1. Systematic capabilities: We do not advocate "lopsided specialization," because even a single application like a code agent involves deep coordination of reasoning, long-text, instruction, dialogue, code, tools, and other capabilities. 2.
